content: This dataset contains 100 UK company records spanning from 1981 to 2025, with 84 active companies (84%) and 16 dissolved (16%). Almost all companies are limited liability companies (98 LTD), with the majority being unique entities by company number and name.
followups: Which company names appear multiple times, and what are the differences between their records (e.g., different company numbers, statuses)?
What is the distribution of company dissolutions over time, and has the rate of dissolution changed in recent years?
Are active companies incorporated more recently than dissolved ones, and what is the average age of each status group?
